hero.lead: Describe what a piece of work needs in plain business language, and GRTA shows you who across your organisation can deliver it, including people you did not know had the skills.

visual.alt: Before: a senior finance manager asks the colleague he always asks, in a dim office with only his usual team around him. After: a younger colleague switches on GRTA, the view zooms out to the whole office, and people with the right skills across many teams light up in orange.

does.label: What GRTA does
does.title: GRTA does three things.

items.title: Finds the competences you already have
items.text: Your organisation already holds CVs, development plans, feedback, courses and project history, but the information is scattered and unstructured. GRTA uses AI to turn it into a full picture of what each person can do and wants to do.

items.title: Turns business needs into competence needs
items.text: Leaders know the problem they need solved, not always the skills it takes. Describe it in your own words, and GRTA translates it into a precise skills brief, asking follow-up questions until it is sharp.

items.title: Puts the two together
items.text: GRTA proposes the people and teams that fit, with alternative line-ups to choose between.

does.why: AI is what makes this possible now. The information has always existed, but until recently no one could use it at scale. GRTA adds something your recruitment and HR systems do not have: a working picture of the competences already inside your organisation.
does.cube: Think of it as the step beyond a competence matrix: a multidimensional competence cube.
does.ctaText: Want to see what GRTA finds in your organisation?

how.label: How it works
how.title: The ABCD process

steps.title: Define the task
steps.text: Describe the need in plain language. GRTA asks follow-up questions until the brief is sharp: skills, scope, timing, budget.

steps.title: Build the competence base
steps.text: GRTA reads CVs plus the sources you already have: development plans, manager and customer feedback, courses and certifications. Your existing systems can feed it directly.

steps.title: Compare
steps.text: GRTA matches what the task needs with what your people offer, using both hard skills and softer evidence.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: You get a shortlist of who fits, with alternative team line-ups to choose between, and availability taken into account if you wish.

how.smallPrint: Each step combines artificial intelligence with business intelligence.
how.screenshotNote: Screenshot of the GRTA platform coming soon
how.cta: See it on your own organisation

get.label: What you get
get.title: See far more of your organisation.
get.lead: You see far more of your organisation than any one manager can, and you act on it the day you need it.

main.title: Hidden talent, found
main.text: The colleague in finance who has run an SAP migration before, or the engineer who negotiates fluently in German. Use what you have before paying consultants for what you don't.

main.title: Next in line, always
main.text: Every qualified person becomes visible, not just the ones their manager happens to know. When someone is busy or moves on, you can see who is ready to step in.

main.title: Always current, not a one-off audit
main.text: Traditional competence mapping takes months and is outdated within days. GRTA stays up to date as your data changes.

get.moreTitle: On top of that, you also get:

more.title: Gaps made visible
more.text: See where you lack skills before a project or bid exposes it.

more.title: Growth for your people
more.text: Employees who want to learn something new get matched to the projects that teach it, so the next project starts with more people who can do it.

more.title: Knowledge that stays
more.text: When managers or teams change, the overview of who can do what stays with the organisation.

get.ctaText: Ready to put your existing people to better use?

together.label: Greater together
together.title: AI that enables people.
together.text: GRTA makes your people's competences visible, so they get to work on more of the assignments they want, and you make better use of the people you already employ.
together.meaning: Greater together means exactly that: people and AI combined achieve more than either alone.
together.ctaText: Interested in shaping GRTA with us? We are looking for a small group of organisations to co-create with.

cases.label: Customer cases
cases.title: What it looks like in practice

items.title: University research
items.text: A university team developing a new project needed competences it could not find in-house. With GRTA, it found them not only at DTU but also at Makerere University in Uganda.

items.title: Consultancy bid
items.text: A consultancy preparing a large public tender had to name five consultants with Salesforce and public-sector experience. GRTA found them in one search, including two in another office the bid team had not considered.

items.title: After a reorganisation
items.text: When a company changed its layer of middle managers, it also lost their overview of who could do what. GRTA rebuilt the overview from existing CVs and feedback, so project leaders could staff new work without relying on former managers' knowledge.

team.label: Who we are
team.title: Built by people who have staffed teams the hard way.
team.lead: GRTA is built by people with decades of enterprise, IT operations and HR experience, who have assembled project teams the hard way and know the need first-hand.

security.label: Security and compliance
security.title: Security and compliance are designed in from the start.

items.text: Dedicated hosting on Danish and European infrastructure, with the option of your own servers and dedicated GPUs
Operated according to ITIL and ISO 27001/27002 principles
GDPR by design: data is used with consent and deleted when someone leaves
GRTA runs inside your organisation, so your organisation stays in control of its data
